summary: Iter60 — Stripe Payments for Company Subscriptions. Backend 11/11 PASS. Frontend E2E Stripe redirect captured live (newco_admin → upgrade-plan-btn → الدفع والترقية → https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_...).

minor.issue: Requires compound_id in body (422 if omitted); company_admin self-registrations always default compound_id → 'default-compound'. Acceptable but undocumented — consider making compound_id optional for role=company_admin.

action_items: OPTIONAL — add dedicated data-testid to the 'الدفع والترقية' button in PlanUpgradeDialog, e.g. data-testid="pay-upgrade-company_business", for stable e2e selection. Test currently falls back to text match.
OPTIONAL — verify the 'ترقية الآن' testid convention. The visible upgrade trigger on CompanyAdminDashboard uses data-testid="upgrade-plan-btn" (NOT 'plan-usage-upgrade-btn'). Keep consistent naming.

ENHANCEMENT — /api/company-admin/plan-usage does NOT expose subscription 'status' (pending_payment/active). Frontend currently cannot know if user is in a pending_payment state without another endpoint — consider adding 'status' to the response so the UI can show a 'أكمل الدفع' CTA for paid-plan admins who skipped checkout.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/stripe_payments.py _activate_subscription: idempotency relies only on payment_status=='paid' check. If Stripe webhook arrives before the polling response updates txn, both paths run update_one — safe but wasteful. Consider wrapping in find_one_and_update with filter {session_id, payment_status:{$ne:'paid'}} for true atomic idempotency.

backend/routes/stripe_payments.py webhook at /api/webhook/stripe: route is public (no auth) and relies solely on signature verification. If STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is not configured inside emergentintegrations, signature check may be lenient — confirm with the library. Add per-IP rate limit for defense in depth.

Frontend PaymentSuccess.js line 50 originally used `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` but the react-hooks plugin is NOT installed in this CRA config, causing CRA to throw 'Definition for rule was not found' as an ERROR that bricked the entire dev build (red overlay on EVERY route). Testing agent removed the offending comment so the build compiles. Main agent should either install eslint-plugin-react-hooks or keep comments generic (`// eslint-disable-next-line`).
PLAN_PRICES is duplicated conceptually with owner_subscriptions catalogue. Consider moving to a shared constants module to prevent drift.

stripe_payments.py does not validate payload.origin_url scheme/host — an attacker could supply origin_url='javascript:alert(1)' as a Stripe success_url. emergentintegrations may sanitize, but defense-in-depth should whitelist http(s) and an allow-list of known frontend hosts.
No cleanup for abandoned payment_transactions rows (status=initiated, created >24h ago) → unbounded growth over time.
